name: strata
description: Use the Strata staging service for evidence-aware business-case work.

interface.shortDescription: Create, develop, and read Strata business cases
interface.longDescription: Elicit and create a coherent initial business case, develop its evidence-backed assumptions, scenarios, Decisions, Outcome Reviews, and Decision Learnings, or resolve exact current state, history, comparisons, and lineage.
defaultPrompt: Use Strata to create a complete business case from a decision idea.
Use Strata to develop evidence-backed drivers, scenarios, and Decision Learning references.
Use Strata to explain a business case from exact current state and history.
